label: MA5800-X7 OLT
description: Huawei SmartAX MA5800-X7 next-generation OLT, 6U chassis with 7 service slots (slots 1-7), 2 control-board slots (8-9) and a universal slot 0; scales to 112 GPON or 56 XGS-PON ports. This spec models one fully populated slot: a 16-port H901GPHF GPON card (gpon1/1-16) plus the 4x 10GE SFP+ uplinks carried on a single MPLA control board and 1 ETH management port = 21 ports. MPLG/MPLH control boards add 2x/4x 100GE.
